## Goal

Connect filesystem and optional privileged observations to durable, confidence-labeled provenance claims and retained agent-session context without overstating who changed a file.

## Deliverables

- Durable provenance claims
- Retained agent-session lifecycle
- FSEvents hint linkage
- Optional Endpoint Security evidence bridge
- Attribution-honesty tests

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-242-01` — FSEvents hints retain event identifiers, flags and rename or gap signals and are linked to observation runs; Endpoint Security observations, when available, remain a distinct stronger source rather than being synthesized from confidence.
- `AC-242-02` — Provenance claims persist method, actor when observed, process ancestry when observed, session link when supported, confidence, basis, time interval, contradictions, and supersession; unknown remains an explicit valid result.
- `AC-242-03` — Agent sessions persist start, heartbeat, end or expiry, workspace and task context across app restart, and historical task-impact queries can use ended retained sessions while clearly labeling temporal or workspace inference.
- `AC-242-04` — Rename, delete, path reuse, overlapping sessions, missing privileged access, dropped FSEvents and offline intervals preserve an ordered and uncertainty-aware chain without assigning unsupported authorship.

## Required Evidence

- `EVREQ-242-01` (provenance-chain-test) — Fixtures for exact privileged events, FSEvents-only inference, unknown actor, rename and path reuse, session restart and expiry, overlapping sessions, dropped events, and export field fidelity.
